With v0.90 metadata
column2: a hot-spare does not become a full member of the

column1: array until recovery is complete.  So if we re-add such a device to
the array
column2: we know that all of it is as up-to-date as the event count

column1: would suggest
column2: and so it a bitmap-based recovery is possible.

column1: However with v1.x metadata
column2: the hot-spare immediately becomes a full

column1: member of the array
column2: but it record how much of the device has been

column1: recovered.  If the array is stopped and re-assembled recovery starts
from this point.
When such a device is hot-added to an array we currently lose the 'how
much is recovered' information and incorrectly included it as a full
in-sync member (after bitmap-based fixup).
This is wrong and unsafe and could corrupt data.
So be more careful about setting saved_raid_disk - which is what
guides the re-adding of devices back into an array.
The new code matches the code in slot_store which does a similar
thing
This is suitable for any -stable kernel.
